headline: E-commerce Specialist
summary: E-commerce specialist with three years running online stores for a Cagayan coffee and native-delicacies brand. I manage the Shopify store and marketplace listings, handle orders from checkout to courier pickup, and create the social media posts that drive shoppers to the store.

experience.title: E-commerce Specialist
bullets: Run the Shopify store and two marketplace shops, with about 1,100 orders a month.
Process orders daily, print waybills and coordinate pickups with three couriers.
Answer shopper messages and resolve delivery problems within a day.
Design product posts in Canva and schedule them on the brand's Facebook and Instagram pages.

experience.title: Online Seller Assistant
bullets: Photographed products and wrote listings for the store's first online shop.
